subject: Supplier governance kit & PO/invoice routing for LumosAI
messages:
From: Eleanor Park <eleanor.park@lumosai.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@lumosai.com
Date: Sun, 13 Dec 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor onboarding requirements & PO routing (LumosAI)

Hi Diego,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Procurement at LumosAI has a short checklist we need to close before we can activate a supplier in our ERP. Can you send the following so we can spin up a PO and process the initial invoice?

- Signed DPA (or DocuSign link)
- SOC 2 Type II report (or secure download link)
- Current subprocessor inventory (CSV preferred)
- Remit-to / invoice instructions and preferred invoice format

We typically issue a PO and pay net-45. Also flag any required insurance certificates or country-of-data-hosting notes. If you can send the files or a governance packet, that would be great.

Best,
Eleanor Park
Vendor Ops | LumosAI
E: eleanor.park@lumosai.com
T: +1 415 555 0192

From: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
To: Eleanor Park <eleanor.park@lumosai.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding requirements & PO routing (LumosAI)

Eleanor — thanks for the checklist and the clear list. I looped in Ben (sales operations) and Marissa (legal/compliance) to make this as painless as possible.

Quick notes and what we can deliver immediately:

- DPA: We maintain a standard DPA and can send via DocuSign. I attached a redline-friendly copy (Redwood_DPA_v2-with-comments.pdf). If LumosAI has standard legal redlines, please upload via the DocuSign link or share with Marissa.
- SOC 2 Type II: We host the report behind a secure link; below is a one-time download link (expires in 7 days).
  - SOC2 Report: https://secure.redwood.ai/soc2/download/LP-guest-2026 (access logs are recorded)
- Subprocessor list: attached CSV (redwood_subprocessors_2026_v2.csv) — we include location, subprocess category, and last review date.
- PO & Invoice routing: We can accept standard PO numbers. Preferred remit: ACH (US bank) or wire. I attached a simple invoice remit template (invoice_remit_template.xlsx) showing fields we expect. Our AP prefers invoices with PO number in the invoice header and a PDF attachment.
- Insurance: We carry a general liability and cyber E&O policy. We can provide certificates on request — Marissa, can you confirm the attachment for insurance?

Next steps:
1) Eleanor sends any contract redlines or upload to the DocuSign link.
2) Ben will follow up with commercial SKU/pricing if Lumos wants to convert trial credits to a committed PO.
3) Once PO is issued, send to ap@redwood.ai with the PO number and we will route payment per the remit template.

Ben/Marissa — can you weigh in on any issues re: DPA redlines or SOC2 sharing?

Thanks,
Diego
Director, Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Eleanor Park <eleanor.park@lumosai.com>, diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding requirements & PO routing (LumosAI)

Hi Eleanor — quick follow.

We're happy to accept LumosAI's preferred PO format. A couple of operational notes:
- Standard commercial terms for trial customers are net-30; for contracted accounts we support net-45 on approved credit. Given Lumos' size, finance will likely approve net-45 with a PO.
- Please include: PO number, billing address, remit address, and your AP contact email on the invoice PDF.
- If Lumos uses EDI, we can accept an EDI 810 but need a short setup (connectivity + test exchange). Our EDI team contact is eproc@redwood.ai — I can introduce if you want to pursue that.

Also, Marissa has reviewed the DPA redline in short order — see her comment below. If the DPA changes are nominal we can proceed with DocuSign and attach SOC2 access logs during onboarding.

I can run a short onboarding playbook once PO is received and confirm activation window (typically 3 business days for standard account setup).

Best,
Ben
Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Eleanor Park <eleanor.park@lumosai.com>, ben_carter@redwood.ai, diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding requirements & PO routing (LumosAI)

Eleanor — looping in final comments from legal/compliance.

1) DPA — thank you for the quick turnaround. Our suggested edits are limited to a) clarifying subprocessor notification timelines (we ask for 30 days), and b) a narrow data deletion clause timeline for test data (45 days post-contract). If these are acceptable we can publish the final DPA via DocuSign. If Lumos needs further negotiation, please send redlines to this thread or upload to the DocuSign envelope (link below).

2) SOC 2 — the link Diego shared is fine. We will provide audited SOC 2 Type II access where needed and can provide a limited NDA for the report if Lumos requires tighter controls.

3) Subprocessors — see attached CSV. We flag two subprocessors that handle payment processing outside the US; if Lumos has localization constraints please call those out and we will provide controls documentation.

4) AP instructions — please send a test invoice once the PO is created to ap@redwood.ai so we can confirm routing. Our standard remit options are in the attached template.

DocuSign link (DPA envelope): https://app.docusign.com/embeddedSigning/signer/abc123-dpa-v2
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.redwood.com/deals/LP-2026-09-98

If that's all acceptable we'll finalize the DPA and queue activation upon PO receipt.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Counsel, Privacy & Security
Redwood Inference
